runtime.start:
umask 077
acl="$STACK_DATA_DIR/users.acl"
if [ ! -e "$acl" ]; then
  printf 'user default on >%s ~* &* +@all\n' "$VALKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD" > "$acl"
fi
exec "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/valkey-server" "$@" --port "$STACK_PORT" --bind 127.0.0.1 --dir "$STACK_DATA_DIR" --unixsocket "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/valkey.sock" --appendonly no --aclfile "$acl"

runtime.provision:
set -eu
result="$(printf 'ACL SETUSER %s reset on >%s ~* &* +@all -@admin\nACL SAVE\n' "$STACK_GROUP" "$REDIS_PASSWORD" | VALKEYCLI_AUTH="$VALKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/valkey-cli" -s "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/valkey.sock" --no-auth-warning 2>&1)"
if [ "$result" != "$(printf 'OK\nOK')" ]; then
  printf 'Valkey refused the group account: %s\n' "$result" >&2
  exit 1
fi

recipes.title: Cache for a Laravel site
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
runtimes:
  php: "8.4"
services:
  - {name: cache, type: valkey}
sites:
  - {name: app, type: laravel}
recipes.gives: Gives the site REDIS_URL, REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REDIS_USERNAME and REDIS_PASSWORD, and the same five prefixed CACHE_, such as CACHE_REDIS_URL.

recipes.title: Two stores, one holding the bare names
recipes.gives: Gives the five REDIS_* variables to cache, the default, and every variable again prefixed CACHE_ or QUEUE_ for each store, such as CACHE_REDIS_URL and QUEUE_REDIS_URL.

recipes.title: valkey-cli in the shell
recipes.gives: Gives valkey-cli in the shell, and the REDIS_* variables; "valkey-cli -u $REDIS_URL" signs in as the group's account.
